summary: Golub Capital Private Income Fund I filed an 8-K reporting the unregistered sale of 119,439 common shares at $24.14 NAV per share, yielding $2.88M, under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D/S. It also disclosed a $0.1667/share regular distribution for April 2026 and provided a portfolio update as of 3/31/26: 135 companies, $403M fair value (99% first-lien floating-rate), $198M NAV, 1.14x leverage. This is a routine periodic disclosure of a continuous offering and distribution, not a special situation.
